requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named PICredibility with all required fields: investigator_name, affiliated_institution, prior_trials_count, completed_trials_count, publications_count, fda_approval_count, prior_trial_outcomes_summary, and composite_credibility_score.
The system must enforce investigator_name as a non-empty string.
The system must enforce affiliated_institution as a nullable string field.
The system must enforce prior_trials_count as an integer greater than or equal to 0.
The system must enforce completed_trials_count as an integer greater than or equal to 0.
The system must enforce publications_count as an integer greater than or equal to 0.
The system must enforce fda_approval_count as an integer greater than or equal to 0.
The system must enforce prior_trial_outcomes_summary as a nullable string field.
The system must enforce composite_credibility_score as a float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must validate that completed_trials_count is less than or equal to prior_trials_count.
The system must serialize the PICredibility model to JSON using field names exactly matching the schema definition.
The system must deserialize valid JSON into the PICredibility model without data loss.
The system must reject inputs where investigator_name is missing or null.
The system must reject inputs where any numeric field contains negative values.
The system must reject inputs where composite_credibility_score is outside the range 0 to 1.
The system must support optional omission of affiliated_institution without raising validation errors.
The system must support optional omission of prior_trial_outcomes_summary without raising validation errors.
The system must provide default values of 0 for prior_trials_count, completed_trials_count, publications_count, and fda_approval_count when not supplied.
The system must include field-level descriptions in the Pydantic model for all schema attributes.
The system must ensure the schema is importable and reusable by downstream services without modification.
